newsitem.title: GREECE: MACEDONIA-THRACE BANK CUTS DEPO, LENDING RATES.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA-THRACE BANK CUTS DEPO, LENDING RATES.

text.p: Macedonia-Thrace Bank said on Thursday it is cutting its lending and deposit rates effective October 1.
Rates on working capital and fixed asset loans will fall by 50 basis points to 18.0 percent and 19.25 percent respectively, it said in a statement.
The bank's new savings deposit rates which went into effect Wednesday September 11 have as follows:
** Savings deposit rates range from 11.50 to 12.25 percent depending on the amount.
** Time deposit rates range from 13.25 to 13.75 percent depending on the maturity.
** Checking deposit rates range from 10.0 to 10.75 percent depending on the amount, Macedonia-Thrace Bank said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
